title: An application or a platform?
sub: Platform and solution architecture, a series on the data platform and what is built on it: why a data platform is a platform and not one more application, what the word means for a vendor's product and for the service an organisation runs, whose logic it carries, and who owns it.
howto: Application blue is an application, with its logic built in; technology green is the platform, shared by every domain; blocks set down on it are each domain's logic, and a gold tag is its owner in the business. Amber, a lantern's colour, is the road every domain shares, in Japan from 1601 and at the utility today.
